offers_products.reason: Manufactures RectorSeal sealants, TRUaire grilles, Jet-Lube lubricants, Balco building components and Greco railings.

offers_services.reason: Almost all revenue is from manufactured products; Smoke Guard installation and service is only a minor regional extra.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Products are sold to professional tradesmen, contractors and industrial users through distributors, not directly to households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to distributors, HVAC and plumbing contractors, builders and industrial, rail, mining and energy businesses.

recurring_revenue.reason: Largest segment sells repeat-order consumable and replacement products like sealants, lubricants and HVAC parts to distributors and contractors.

cyclical_demand.reason: Largest part sells HVAC, plumbing and construction products tied to building activity, which can be postponed; maintenance lubricants are steadier.

big_ticket.reason: Sells small, frequent items like sealants, lubricants, grilles and connectors, though Balco and Smoke Guard sell project-based building components.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for manufactured goods such as sealants, lubricants and grilles, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main buyers are distributors, professional contractors and tradesmen, plus industrial maintenance customers, not mainly large enterprises or government.

asset_heavy.reason: Manufactures niche products like grilles, lubricants and railings; moderate plant needs, not utility-like heavy assets.

notes: Segment mix is judged from general knowledge: Contractor Solutions is the largest segment, sold mostly through distributors.
